# Knowledge catalog

| File Path                                                                                              | Knowledge Type | When to Read                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [knowledge/documentation/maintained-document-quality.md](documentation/maintained-document-quality.md) | evergreen      | Read when maintaining durable guidance.                          |
| [knowledge/documentation/delivery-evidence.md](documentation/delivery-evidence.md)                     | evergreen      | Read when deciding whether documentation delivery is complete.   |
| [knowledge/documentation/route-review.md](documentation/route-review.md)                               | evergreen      | Read when reviewing documentation routes.                        |
| [knowledge/documentation/current-renderer.md](documentation/current-renderer.md)                       | time-sensitive | Read when guidance depends on the current Acme renderer.         |
| [knowledge/documentation/catalog-only.md](documentation/catalog-only.md)                               | evergreen      | Read when catalog inventory behavior is discussed.               |
| [knowledge/documentation/test-only.md](documentation/test-only.md)                                     | evergreen      | Read when a test fixture mentions documentation behavior.        |
| [knowledge/documentation/knowledge-only.md](documentation/knowledge-only.md)                           | time-sensitive | Read when another Knowledge document mentions the legacy format. |
